text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Eishin
Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Look, they have Umamusume plushies as
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Eishin Flash is
pointing and
see a claw machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is a glaring absence of detail, but
the cute
features on them are rather
endearing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. There is a large obstacle to winning
this
game, and that is the machine itself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Despite the necessity of precise
operation down
to the millimeter in
order to win a prize, the
control system
is very inaccurate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Worse, the claw's flawed design makes
grasping
objects incredibly inefficient.
Such conditions are
grossly unfair.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You do seem rather confident. Very
well, I entrust
you with this endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
